signInDescription: Sign in from your browser to continue in Lody.
signInHint: Lody opens lody.ai in your browser. Approve this device there, then come back.
signInFootnote: An independent native client for Lody Cloud. It signs in with Lody's device flow and keeps your session in the macOS Keychain.
signInConfirmCode: Confirm this code in your browser

settingsThemeHelp: Follow the system, or keep Lody light or dark.

settingsProjectsHelp: The folders each machine works in. Add one with the Lody app or CLI on the machine.
settingsAboutDescription: A native Lody client: MyGo draws it on the GPU, without a web view, and it syncs with Lody Cloud directly.

billingUnavailable: Billing isn't available for this workspace.
sharesHelp: Static copies you have published. Admins see every share in the workspace.

machinesNoFolders: No connected folders on this machine.
machinesFolderHint: Sharing a folder also makes this machine available to the workspace.
machinesNoAgents: No agents configured for this machine.
billingReferralHelp: Friends get 10% off their first payment; you get 20% of it as credit.
billingMembersHelp: New seats are prorated by day and charged at the next renewal; removing a member doesn't refund this period.
billingRenewalLine: {seats, plural, one {Standard subscription · # seat} other {Standard subscription · # seats}}
billingRedeemHelp: Gift time starts after the time already paid for or redeemed.
billingPaymentHelp: Change the card future payments are charged to, on Stripe.
mcpLead: The MCP servers this workspace shares; each session chooses which to load.
mcpNone: No MCP servers yet. Add one to share it with every session.
mcpToolsLocal: Tools load through the Lody daemon on this computer, which runs the command or reaches the URL.
mcpDeleteBody: Sessions that load it lose its tools from their next turn.
mcpDialogLead: This connection is shared with the workspace. Once saved, machines run the command or connect to the URL to read its tools. Save only configurations you trust.
mcpDescriptionHint: Optional. Sessions see it when choosing servers.
mcpConnectionHint: Values may use {example} for the target machine's environment.
workspaceTransferHelp: Make another member the owner; you become an admin.
workspaceTransferNoOne: Invite other members to the workspace first.
workspaceDeleteHelp: Permanently delete this workspace and all its data. This can't be undone.
workspaceDeletePaying: This workspace still has a subscription. Cancel it on lody.ai first; the workspace can be deleted once it won't renew.
workspaceLeaveHelp: You lose access to its chats and machines.
memberRemoveBody: They lose access to the workspace.
joinHelp: Others can ask to join through the link; only you approve them.
joinApproveWeb: Approve on lody.ai (adds a paid seat)
inviteLead: They get an email with a link to join.
inviteLimit: The workspace has reached its member limit. Add seats on lody.ai.

tokenOnce: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.

passwordSent: We emailed {email} a link to set your password.
passwordChangeHelp: Changing it signs you out everywhere.
machinesRevokeBody: The machine is signed out of every workspace and must sign in again.
machinesRemoveBody: If its Lody CLI connects again, the machine comes back.
machinesRemoveOnline: Only an offline machine can be removed.

providerUnclosedQuote: The command has an unclosed quote.

providerNameHint: Shown in the provider list and the chats' menus.
providerCommandHint: Quotes and backslashes work as in a shell; variables and pipes don't.

providerTitleGenHint: Test the provider to load the options.
providerPromptPlaceholder: Instructions every chat with this provider starts with
providerTesting: Starting the agent on the machine…
memoryLead: The memories each machine imports into Lody.

memoryNotInstalled: Nowledge Mem isn't installed on this machine.
memoryNotRunning: Nowledge Mem isn't running on this machine.

memoryNothingToImport: Every memory on this machine is imported already.
projectAddLead: Choose a folder on the machine.
projectRemoveBody: Lody forgets the folder; its files stay on the machine.
projectRemoveChats: {n, plural, one {Its chat is archived. Lody forgets the folder; its files stay on the machine.} other {Its # chats are archived. Lody forgets the folder; its files stay on the machine.}}
shortcutsLead: Save prompts to send with a slash command. Each says where it applies; with none set it works anywhere in this workspace. Private unless you share it.
shortcutsNone: No Prompt Shortcuts yet. Save a prompt you write often and send it with /.
shortcutsDeleteBody: It's removed for everyone who could use it.
shortcutsDialogLead: Saved in this workspace and sent as one message.
shortcutsPromptHint: Sent as one message, anywhere in this workspace.
shortcutsShareHint: Off by default. Sharing and scope are separate things.
rolesLead: Named setups of an agent: its prompt, model and machines. Mention one with @ to hand it a task.
rolePromptHint: Put before every task handed to the role.
roleWhereHint: The machines it may run on, each with its agent, model, mode and memory.
roleShareHint: Members can mention it with @; only you edit it.
roleDescriptionLimit: The description is at most 140 characters.
roleNeedsAgent: Choose an agent on at least one machine.
rolesDeleteBody: Chats can no longer mention it.
projectPageGeneralLead: Where the project is, and who may use it.
projectPageWorktreeLead: Scripts run when a chat makes its own worktree, and when the chat is archived.
projectPageSkillsLead: The skills agents find in this project.
projectPageMCPLead: The MCP servers new chats in this project start with. The composer can still change them.
projectMachineOffline: {name} is offline. Worktree setup and skills load when it comes online.
projectShareHint: Members can start chats in this folder on your machine.
projectDeleteSafe: Lody never deletes the project's folder or its files.
worktreeSetupLead: Runs after the git worktree is made, before the agent starts.
worktreeCleanupLead: Runs when a chat is archived, before its worktree is removed.

projectMCPNotOwner: Only the owner of the project's machine changes its defaults.

historyInitialHint: Find this project's conversations in {provider}, then choose which ones to import.
historyEmptyHint: Start a conversation for this project in {provider}, then sync again.
